# BASS runtime

`win-x64/bass.dll` is the official 64-bit Windows build of BASS 2.4.18 from Un4seen Developments.

- Source package: https://www.un4seen.com/files/bass24.zip
- SHA-256: `FEBB2CF1882D554C3A958280777DA0B69F07DE6E262DF271DE11C56E4A54AFD4`
- Included licence and documentation: `../../licenses/BASS-2.4.txt`

BASS is proprietary and free only for non-commercial use. It is deliberately kept outside the AMC assemblies and may be removed to obtain a build which uses only the existing fallback radio decoders. Commercial redistribution requires the appropriate BASS licence.
